The change bounds each mort subtable’s reader to that subtable’s bytes and interprets contextual substitution offsets as signed word offsets. For each nonzero offset, it reads all glyph replacements from `ceil(substOffset / 2) - offset` through `floor(size / 2) - offset`, clipped to the glyph range, so complete words inside both boundaries are included for negative and positive offsets alike.
